exposure: awareness of a locally produced fortified complementary food product
availability of a locally produced fortified complementary food product
outcome: message coverage of fortified complementary food
contact coverage of fortified complementary food
partial coverage of fortified complementary food
effective coverage of fortified complementary food
infant and young child feeding (IYCF) practices
cohort: The study included 1,113 caregivers of children aged 0-23 months living in Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire.
finding: The study found high message coverage (85.0%) for the fortified complementary food, but moderate contact coverage (37.8%) and poor partial (8.8%) and effective coverages (4.6%), with generally poor IYCF practices.
